desc:
🚢 SHIP SURVIVAL


Vote for your ship, board with your crew and survive whatever the ocean throws at you. No round is the same: storms, rough seas, burning oil spills, icebergs, torpedoes, a tsunami – and something big lurking below the waves… 🦈

Like the game for more Updates

🌊 Realistic sinking – water floods in through broken windows and holes, rooms fill up and your ship can capsize.
🩹 Injuries – break your legs, crawl, limp and fight to stay alive.
🏊 Swim for your life – the water is cold, every second counts.
⭐ 16 ranks – work your way up from Ship’s Boy to Captain, each rank comes with its own job on board.
🛒 Survival gear – earn Cash and unlock life jackets, flashlights, repair kits, extinguishers, first aid kits, diving masks… or fire a flare and call a lifeboat!
👻 Died? Spectate the survivors or come back as a ghost.

🏆 Be the last one standing and climb the leaderboard!

👍 Like & favorite the game for a free reward in the lobby!
